cohort: Singleton deliveries in California from 2005 to 2008
finding: Pregnancies affected by prenatally diagnosed Klinefelter Syndrome are at an increased risk of adverse fetal and neonatal outcomes, including preterm delivery, cesarean delivery, RDS, small for gestational age, neonatal death, and infant death.
mod_finding: Pregnancies complicated by prenatally diagnosed Klinefelter Syndrome had higher rates of cesarean delivery compared to unaffected deliveries.
